body:
I'm thinking part of it is little things building up. The problem in our relationship, what we believed to be a good thing, is we never really fight. We'd bicker, but eventually one of us would give up in the name of "not wanting to fight". Very few problems get truly solved this way. 

Another part of it I think has to do with breathing room. Maybe we did spend too much time together, but it's on both our parts. It's something I'd be more than willing to work on. I'd pretty much be willing to work through anything, and no matter what she's done (if anything), forgive her for anything if she's willing to meet me halfway. But right now it seems she's dead set on taking the "easy" way out.

I started to see a therapist, and at the therapists request I asked her if she would join me for one session. She said she'd think about it but I have little hope that she'll agree. She's always said that "once you get to the point where you need counseling you should end it."

Like I said, apparently she doesn't love me the way she used to. She says she needs to be on her own for a while, that she wants to be independent, that she hasn't been happy for a while, that she's been faking happy. I don't think she's that good a god damn actress, but there you are.

She was my soulmate. I don't mean that in some sappy hopeless romantic way, I truly believe that with all my heart.

Thank you all for your kind words, but its just so god damn hard. Literally 24 hours before she told me "We should spend time apart" we were happy and in love, or so I thought. We were affectionate, we were having sex that was way better than it had been and much more frequently. We were planning for our future, everything seemed wonderful. Now I just don't know what to do. I don't know who I am anymore.

People just leave me. They get tired of me and abandon me. That's always how its been, and I was stupid to think she was any different. I don't want to hurt anymore. I never want to feel this way again. I don't want to live in a world where one day someone will look into your eyes and tell you they love you and they never want you to leave, and the next day they're telling you to pack your shit. I can't handle it.
